result.explanation: The controller keeps committed value, draft text, validation error, and disabled mode. Inputs edit only draft; commits parse safe signed integers and snap to the nearest legal lattice value, with ties downward. Cancel and stepping canonicalize the draft.
result.mapping: config defines the legal lattice; state stores value, draft, error, and disabled; event selects edit, commit, step, cancel, or mode transitions; output exposes value, draft, dirty, error, and disabled.
result.assumptions: Inputs satisfy the published schema and numeric safety guarantees. The supplied config remains the configuration for the trace. No ambient state, timing, randomness, imports, or external effects are used.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;for(const o of output){if(!o||typeof o!=="object"||Object.keys(o).sort().join(",")!=="disabled,dirty,draft,error,value"||typeof o.draft!=="string"||typeof o.dirty!=="boolean"||(o.error!==null&&o.error!=="invalid")||typeof o.disabled!=="boolean"||typeof o.value!=="number")return false}return output.length===0||output[0].dirty===false?false:true}
